data.name: Aluf
data.gender_notes: Aluf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-L-F' meaning exalted, noble, and sublime. The name Aluf carries the meaning “Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aluf usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes a sense of divine elevation and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Aluf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aluf total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الوف
in_arabic.meaning: الوف تعني الصديق الوفي والرفيق الخفي
in_arabic.long_meaning: الوف هو اسم عربي مشتق من جذر و-ف-ي الذي يدل على الوفاء والإخلاص. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخص الذي يتميز بالصداقة الحميمة والوفاء. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الصداقة والعلاقات الإنسانية.

in_urdu.name: الوف
in_urdu.long_meaning: الوف ایک عربی نام ہے جو و-ف-ي جذر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وفاء اور مخلص۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں یہ نام کسی ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو وفادار اور مخلص ہو۔ اس کا تعلق اسلامی تقویم اور ثقافت سے ہے جہاں وفاء کو اہم صفت माना جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलूफ
in_hindi.meaning: अलूफ का अर्थ है वफादार मित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलूफ एक अरबी नाम है जो व-फ-य मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वफादारी और सच्चाई। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो वफादार और सच्चा होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है जहां वफादारी को एक आवश्यक गुण माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Aluf
in_english.meaning: Aluf means loyal friend or companion
in_english.long_meaning: Aluf is an Arabic name derived from the root v-f-y, which signifies loyalty and sincerity. In Islamic tradition, the name Aluf is used to describe someone who is a loyal and trustworthy friend. The root v-f-y is mentioned in the Quran in the context of friendship and human relationships. The name carries a spiritual significance, reflecting the importance of loyalty and sincerity in Islam. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with these noble qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aluf was commonly given to leaders, rulers, judges, or wise men in Islamic and Arabic societies. It emphasized their noble status, high character, and power to govern and make decisions. In tribal communities, a person with the name Aluf may hold a significant role in social functions and decision-making processes.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aluf brings attention to the concept of Ihsan (excellence or perfecting oneself). The name Aluf encourages a virtuous life of continuing to seek wisdom, knowledge, and self-improvement to become a more noble and exalted human being. In essence, to strive towards an Aluf-like character in conformity with Allah's guidelines.
